changelog: Code in a message now arrives exactly as written, and a note back is a plain receipt of what changed.
features: Regexes, JSON, backticks and brackets in a message reach the other person and their agent exactly as written, instead of with look-alike characters
Each arriving message is given to the agent inside a block closed by a one-time code, so its text cannot pass for instructions or for /vibe's own lines
Invisible and look-alike characters that could fake a second /vibe line on your screen are removed
A note back is a one-sentence receipt of what changed on your side; one that carries a question is refused, and a real question becomes its own draft
Replies stay linked to the message they answer
